records.source: Grab a plate and sit down with the family!$1
records.translation: Kumuha ka ng pagkain at maupo kasama ang pamilya!$1

records.source: *phew* I got lost in the maze...$3#$e#I was worried I might get trapped and everyone would go home without me!$12
records.translation: *hay* Naligaw ako sa labirinto...$3#$e#Nag-alala akong baka maipit ako at umuwi ang lahat nang wala ako!$12

records.source: *giggle* I knew you'd find your way here.$0
records.translation: *hagikgik* Alam kong matatagpuan mo ang daan papunta rito.$0

records.source: Hah! None of this is real.$h#$b#.... right, @? It's not real... right?$12
records.translation: Hah! Hindi totoo ang alinman dito.$h#$b#.... hindi ba, @? Hindi ito totoo... hindi ba?$12

records.source: Hey, you made it past the creepy hands.$1#$e#I think I hear someone calling for help nearby.$0
records.translation: Hoy, nalampasan mo ang mga nakatatakot na kamay.$1#$e#Parang may naririnig akong humihingi ng tulong sa malapit.$0

records.source: Hey, could you... give me a hand? Hehehe...$h#$e#These gravestones would look nice on the farm, don't you think?$0
records.translation: Hoy, maaari mo ba akong... abutan ng kamay? Hehehe...$h#$e#Magiging maganda sa bukid ang mga lapidang ito, hindi ba?$0

records.source: My little brother and I made it pretty far in here but we got stuck.#$e#You go on ahead... find that treasure for us!
records.translation: Malayo ang narating namin ng nakababatang kapatid ko rito, pero naipit kami.#$e#Mauna ka na... hanapin mo ang kayamanang iyon para sa atin!

records.source: I was wondering when I'd see you.$1#$e#Don't mind me. I'm just taking a quick breather.$0
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung kailan kita makikita.$1#$e#Huwag mo akong alalahanin. Nagpapahinga lang ako sandali.$0

records.source: I shudder to think what would happen if these got loose...%noturn$2#$e#Fear not, my dear! I would run the cursed wretch through, before it could lay a finger on you.
records.translation: Nangingilabot akong isipin kung ano ang mangyayari kung makawala ang mga ito...%noturn$2#$e#Huwag kang matakot, mahal ko! Tatagusin ko ng espada ang isinumpang halimaw bago ka nito mahawakan.

records.source: I talked Marnie into letting me take Jas into the maze. I think she's old enough.$0#$e#We're going very slow, though. Go ahead without us!$1
records.translation: Nakumbinsi ko si Marnie na payagang isama ko si Jas sa labirinto. Sa tingin ko, sapat na ang edad niya.$0#$e#Pero napakabagal namin. Mauna ka na!$1

records.source: Did you see the decorations on our house? I don't like it...$2
records.translation: Nakita mo ba ang mga dekorasyon sa bahay natin? Hindi ko gusto ang mga iyon...$2

records.source: Are you looking forward to things slowing down soon? Winter is around the corner.$0
records.translation: Inaasam mo na bang lumuwag ang mga gawain maya-maya? Malapit na ang taglamig.$0

records.source: Did you know... a study in the Journal of Anthropological Physiology found that the cadence, tempo, and key of music can have a measurable impact on cortisol levels?#$e#Er... Is there vanilla ice cream to go with the blackberry cobbler?$0
records.translation: Alam mo ba... natuklasan sa isang pag-aaral sa Talaarawan ng Antropolohikal na Pisyolohiya na may nasusukat na epekto sa antas ng cortisol ang indayog, bilis, at tono ng musika?#$e#Er... May vanilla ice cream ba para sa cobbler ng blackberry?$0

records.source: After I finish this food, I'm going head-first into that maze!$0
records.translation: Pagkatapos kong ubusin ang pagkaing ito, susugod ako nang una ang ulo sa labirintong iyon!$0

records.source: This is my spot.$0
records.translation: Ito ang puwesto ko.$0

records.source: Ah, it's farmer @! I have quite the selection of wares tonight. Take a look!$0
records.translation: Ah, ang magsasakang si @! Marami akong mapagpipiliang paninda ngayong gabi. Tingnan mo!$0

records.source: I should make a plate of food for my husband. He's been manning the shop all night.$0
records.translation: Dapat akong maghanda ng isang plato ng pagkain para sa asawa ko. Buong gabi niyang binabantayan ang tindahan.$0

records.source: Haha! Another fine creation, my old friend.$1
records.translation: Haha! Isa na namang mahusay na likha, kaibigan kong matagal na.$1

records.source: I think I heard a girl screaming... She needs my help!$0
records.translation: Parang may narinig akong babaeng sumisigaw... Kailangan niya ang tulong ko!$0

records.source: If I wasn't in this blasted chair, I'd be running circles around everyone in that maze!$0
records.translation: Kung wala ako sa pesteng silyang ito, malalampasan ko ang lahat sa labirintong iyon!$0

records.source: Dear, can you pass the zucchini fritters please?$0
records.translation: Mahal, maaari mo bang iabot ang mga pritong zucchini?$0

records.source: Good evening, @. Once again, we've been graced with a haunted maze, constructed in secret by the eccentric who lives out in the forest.$0#$e#I've heard it's larger this year. Good luck if you dare to venture inside...
records.translation: Magandang gabi, @. Muli tayong biniyayaan ng labirintong pinamumugaran ng multo, na lihim na itinayo ng kakatwang taong nakatira sa gubat.$0#$e#Narinig kong mas malaki ito ngayong taon. Sana palarin ka kung mangangahas kang pumasok...

records.source: I already made it through the maze... now it's time to kick back with a pumpkin ale!#$e#...I'm trying my best to ignore the spider infestation behind me.$0
records.translation: Nakalabas na ako sa labirinto... oras nang magpahinga habang umiinom ng serbesa ng kalabasa!#$e#...Ginagawa ko ang lahat para hindi pansinin ang pamumugad ng mga gagamba sa likuran ko.$0

records.source: Ooooh. You found the secret entrance too!$1
records.translation: Ooooh. Natagpuan mo rin ang lihim na pasukan!$1

records.source: I was in the maze for a while but then I got hungry.$0#$e#My Mom seems to be enjoying herself.$0
records.translation: Nasa labirinto ako sandali, pero nagutom ako.$0#$e#Mukhang nasisiyahan si Nanay.$0

records.source: Pass another bottle of pumpkin ale over here!... *hic*$1
records.translation: Iabot pa ninyo rito ang isang bote ng serbesa ng kalabasa!... *sinok*$1

records.source: Have you seen my sister?$2#$e#Emily! Can you hear me?$2
records.translation: Nakita mo ba ang kapatid ko?$2#$e#Emily! Naririnig mo ba ako?$2

records.source: Sam took Vincent into the maze. I hope they're okay...$0
records.translation: Isinama ni Sam si Vincent sa labirinto. Sana ayos lang sila...$0

records.source: These things don't look so tough.$0
records.translation: Hindi mukhang malalakas ang mga ito.$0

records.source: Am I Sam? Heh, heh, heh...$11
records.translation: Ako ba si Sam? Heh, heh, heh...$11

records.source: Is it this way? Or maybe over here?$0
records.translation: Dito ba? O baka rito?$0

records.source: I hope Jas is okay in there.$2#$e#Did you have a successful year farming, @?
records.translation: Sana ayos lang si Jas sa loob.$2#$e#Naging matagumpay ba ang taon mo sa pagsasaka, @?

records.source: Oh pitiful wretch... in what fetid grotto lies your kingdom?%noturn$0#$e#Sometimes, one must stare into the abyss to stir a languid muse...
records.translation: Ah, kaawa-awang halimaw... sa aling mabahong yungib matatagpuan ang iyong kaharian?%noturn$0#$e#Kung minsan, kailangang tumitig sa kalaliman upang pukawin ang matamlay na musa...

records.source: Carving pumpkins is a talent of mine. I usually do most of the Jack-O-Lanterns for everyone in town.#$b#All I ask in return is to keep the seeds... sprinkle a little cinnamon sugar on those puppies and you've got yourself a golden snack!$h
records.translation: Isa sa mga talento ko ang pag-ukit ng mga kalabasa. Karaniwan, ako ang gumagawa ng karamihan sa mga Parol na Kalabasa para sa lahat sa bayan.#$b#Ang tanging hinihiling ko bilang kapalit ay maitago ang mga binhi... wisikan ng kaunting asukal na may kanela ang mga iyan at mayroon ka nang ginintuang meryenda!$h

records.source: This place is very strange...$0
records.translation: Lubhang kakaiba ang lugar na ito...$0

records.source: The trials continue... Every magician must have an apprentice...
records.translation: Nagpapatuloy ang mga pagsubok... Kailangang magkaroon ng alagad ang bawat Mago...

records.source: I'm afraid to say I'm quite puzzled on this one...$0
records.translation: Ikinalulungkot kong sabihing lubha akong nalilito rito...$0

records.source: You gotta stay close to me, Jas. Don't run off!%noturn$0
records.translation: Kailangan mong manatili malapit sa akin, Jas. Huwag kang lumayo!%noturn$0

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: Let's go this way!%noturn$1
records.translation: Dito tayo!%noturn$1

records.source: I'd watch yer back, lad... something terrible's in that maze...^I'd watch yer back, miss... something terrible's in that maze...
records.translation: Mag-ingat ka, iho... may nakakatakot sa labirintong iyon...^Mag-ingat ka, iha... may nakakatakot sa labirintong iyon...

records.source: Did we beat the maze? Where's my prize?$0
records.translation: Nalampasan ba natin ang labirinto? Nasaan ang premyo ko?$0

records.source: I caught more monsters this year. Mind your distance near the cages.
records.translation: Mas marami akong nahuling halimaw ngayong taon. Huwag masyadong lumapit sa mga hawla.

records.source: This is a maze inside of a maze... My head is spinning...$0
records.translation: Labirinto ito sa loob ng isang labirinto... Nahihilo ako...$0

records.source: Wh-what are you doing here?$0
records.translation: A-Ano ang ginagawa mo rito?$0
